project_title: DomainForge AI - No-Code Expert Agent Builder for Social Good
tagline: You understand the problem. We help build the agent.
archetype: ORGANIC & TACTILE ACCESSIBLE TECH (Archetype 1 + High Contrast Swiss Hybrid)
emotional_tone: Empowering, human-centric, high-trust, accessible, clear, and action-oriented
theme_strategy: Hybrid Light Default with Accessible Dark Contrast Toggle. High contrast AA/AAA compliant text with warm sand/emerald/slate tones for human empathy and crisp visual hierarchy.

heading_styles.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.15]
heading_styles.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.2]

typography.eyebrow: uppercase text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400

accessibility_standards.wcag_compliance: WCAG 2.2 AA / AAA for text contrast (minimum 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large UI)
accessibility_standards.focus_indicators: Mandatory 3px solid focus ring with offset (`focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-blue-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2`) on all interactive controls
accessibility_standards.keyboard_navigation: Full keyboard accessibility: Tab sequence, Enter/Space activation, Esc modal dismiss, Arrow keys for workspace tabs
accessibility_standards.screen_readers: aria-label, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-current, and role attributes on custom dropdowns, tabs, workflow diagrams, and action buttons
accessibility_standards.text_resizing: Supports browser text zoom up to 200% without layout clipping or text overlap
accessibility_standards.reduced_motion: Honors `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by disabling smooth scroll and heavy Framer Motion transitions
accessibility_standards.demo_indicators: High-visibility badges for Demo Mode, Sample Data, and Simulated Backend Execution

layout_patterns.navigation: Sticky accessible header with blur backdrop (`backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 z-50`), logo + tagline, high-contrast nav links, theme toggle, high-visibility 'Create Agent' CTA, and active keyboard indicator.

landing_dashboard.hero_section: Asymmetric Bento hero: Left column narrative headline + plain-language problem prompt box + quick launch CTAs ('Try Guided Demo', 'Create an Agent'). Right column live interactive demo card showing Civil Engineering Urban Waterlogging Agent preview.
landing_dashboard.social_good_banner: Dedicated Social Good & Accessibility callout card highlighting domain expert empowerment without coding barriers.
landing_dashboard.community_demos_grid: Tetris Grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6`) presenting community templates with domain tags (Civil Engineering, Accessibility, Public Health, Agriculture).
landing_dashboard.empty_and_user_agents: Section displaying user's created agents with empty-state invitation card ('No custom agents yet - launch the 3-minute wizard').

creation_wizard.type: Multi-step guided wizard (4 steps: 1. Problem Description, 2. Data & Resources, 3. Goal & Output, 4. AI Proposal Review)
creation_wizard.step_indicator: Accessible step progress bar with active step announcer (`aria-current='step'`), checkmarks for completed steps, and clear visual numbers.
creation_wizard.guidance: In-context domain helper text, sample prompt inserters ('Insert Sample: Urban Flooding' / 'Insert Sample: Sidewalk Ramp Audit'), and plain-language guidance boxes.

agent_workspace.layout: Header with agent status (Draft / Test Mode / Published), version badge, sample data toggle, and 8 tabbed views (`Overview`, `Workflow`, `Data & Tools`, `Run`, `Results`, `Activity`, `Improve`, `Deploy`).
agent_workspace.tab_workflow: Visual flow diagram with ordered node steps (Input Parse -> Spatial Hydrology Model -> Risk Classification -> Mitigation Action Plan), tool execution indicators, and click-to-edit step inspector.
agent_workspace.tab_run: Interactive split view: Left input parameters form + chat interface; Right live tool execution log with step-by-step spinner/success indicators.
agent_workspace.tab_results: Structured report renderer with key metrics widgets, bar/pie charts (Recharts), spatial risk list, and PDF/CSV export options.
agent_workspace.tab_improve: Feedback iteration interface with before-and-after prompt comparison, version history log, and re-evaluation trigger.
agent_workspace.tab_deploy: Deployment checklist (Accessibility Audit, Plain Language Check, Data Privacy, Tool Verification) with one-click 'Publish Agent Page' button generating shareable slug URL.

public_published_page.header: Clean visitor header with 'Built with DomainForge' badge, domain tags, author info, and social share button.
public_published_page.content: Distraction-free workspace containing plain-language user input form, sample dataset launcher, instant run button, interactive progress, and structured result viewer.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or rounded-lg styling with clear contrast. Primary: `bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 text-white font-semibold shadow-sm focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-blue-600 transition-colors`. Secondary: `bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-medium`.
component_guidelines.cards: Layered surface cards with explicit 1px subtle borders (`border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:border-teal-500/50 transition-all`). Internal padding enforced (`p-6` or `p-8`) to prevent text collision.
component_guidelines.inputs_and_selects: Accessible Shadcn Form inputs (`Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Checkbox`) wrapped with `<label>` element, visible field hint, clear focus ring, and error text with `aria-describedby`.
component_guidelines.badges: High-contrast status badges: Success (`bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-200 border border-emerald-300`), Warning (`bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200`), Info (`bg-sky-100 text-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-950 dark:text-sky-200`), Demo Mode (`bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-200 font-bold`).
component_guidelines.workflow_nodes: Custom step cards linked with animated connecting arrows/lines, showing step number, step title, plain-language description, assigned tool icon, and execution status pill.
component_guidelines.toasts: Sonner toast system configured with clear high-contrast icons for creation success, run completion, and publish events.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL key interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, workspace tab buttons, published page controls) have clear `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid='create-agent-btn'`, `data-testid='tab-workflow'`).
Implement light and dark mode toggle using React state or next-themes pattern, defaulting to clean high-contrast light theme with rich dark slate mode.

Build pre-populated interactive sample data for the 'Urban Waterlogging Analysis Agent' (civil engineering problem prompt, rainfall elevation dataset, workflow nodes, sample simulation output with map/metrics) and 'Community Accessibility Audit Template'.
Ensure wizard supports 1-click 'Fill with Sample Data' so hackathon judges can immediately test agent creation without typing long prompts.
Ensure workspace includes live run simulation with animated step-by-step workflow completion, realistic log output, and visual structured results.
Ensure deploy flow lets users toggle status to Published and navigate to the standalone public agent page (`/published/:id`).
Keep standard JavaScript / React `.js` / `.jsx` file extensions as configured in project.
